::: {#def-brnffrcistg .theorem}
## BRNFFRCISTG model

A bipartite random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (BRNFFRCISTG) is a causal model of a [bipartite NPSEM-GE](#def-bipartite-npsem-ie) that satisfies (1) [no within-covariate influence](#def-no-spillover), (2) [homogeneous random network interference](#def-homogenous-random-network-interference), (3) [identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions), and (4) [single-world independence](#def-single-world) over the structural variables, as in the [RNFFRCISTG](#def-rnffrcitg).

Units attach to a shared set of places, so repeated attachments do the work that repeated units do under no interference, and the effects of place-level regimes --- where to vaccinate, say --- are identified given positivity. Regimes acting directly on person-to-person ties are not reached by this model.
:::
